name: Unlock Cooking With Massimo
summary: Route through D.G. progress, Massimo, and the first stove before spending rare inputs.
steps: Push D.G. progress until cooking route appears
Find Massimo near cafe or town center
Place or use a stove
Cook one low-risk starter recipe before spending rare inputs

name: Low-Risk Jam Route
summary: Turn repeatable fruit into low-risk jam tests before using late crops or limited rewards.
steps: Collect four repeatable fruit
Use Mixed Jam before single-fruit variants
Check Pineapple or Strawberry only after crop route is stable
Record value before mass cooking

name: Fish And Chips Route
summary: Combine routine fish and Potato only after checking whether cooking beats raw sale.
steps: Run routine lake or coastal fishing first
Keep two Potato from the crop route
Open Recipe Finder before cooking
Compare cooked value against raw sale

name: Vegetable Sink Route
summary: Use excess vegetables for House Salad, Tomato Plate, Carrot Dish, and Corn overlap decisions.
steps: Use excess vegetables before rare ingredients
Check Tomato Plate and Carrot Dish after crop unlock
Keep Corn overlap separate from animal food tests
Use Crop Planner before planting for cooking only

name: QTE Safety Route
summary: Practice timing with cheap ingredients so rare inputs do not become Bizarre Food.
steps: Practice QTE with low-cost ingredients
Pause rare input cooking until timing is reliable
Treat Bizarre Food as a failed-output warning
Use checklist for event or rare cooking sessions

name: Event Ingredient Route
summary: Avoid wasting limited event materials until the event window, recipe value, and prep route are clear.
steps: Check active event status before cooking limited items
Confirm recipe value before spending event materials
Keep prep tasks in Events or Checklist
Archive results after event window ends
